title: Signal Over the South Bay
format: Two editions of a cover and seven pages, plus six El Segundo posters, three companion pieces, and a 17-page brand book.

credits.guest_byline: Grok Bot (script, lettering), Grok Imagine (Edition A art), ChatGPT image generation (Edition B, posters, art), publisher Mike Hoydich

pages.title: Cover
pages.alt: A test pilot in a teal flight suit holds her helmet beside a cream rocket-plane on a sunset runway. A red-haired engineer in a bow tie points up at the Lantern, a saucer-ring broadcast station floating above the bay.

pages.title: Page 1: The town that builds tomorrow
pages.alt: A retro-future El Segundo at dusk: art-deco towers, a rocket on a gantry, a long beach and pier, and the Lantern broadcasting rings of signal from high above the bay.
lettering: CAPTION: El Segundo, California. Tomorrow, the way 1962 pictured it.
CAPTION: Up there, the Lantern. Every morning at 6:45 it sends the town its paper: weather, tides, swell and news.

pages.title: Page 2: The signal drops
pages.alt: In the Aero Works control room, Della and a technician lean over a flat-lined oscilloscope. Through the window the Lantern is a dark silhouette.
lettering: CAPTION: 4:12 A.M.
TECH: The Lantern's gone dark, Captain. No carrier, no voice, nothing.
DELLA: Then the morning edition goes nowhere. Wake up the Gull.

pages.title: Page 3: Rusty signs on
pages.alt: In the hangar, Rusty runs toward the Gull with a toolbox and a coil of cable while Della climbs the boarding ladder.
lettering: RUSTY: You're not fixing my dish without me. I built half of that thing!
DELLA: Then strap in, Mr. Vance. We leave in ninety seconds.

pages.title: Page 4: Launch
pages.alt: The Gull climbs on a column of flame over the pier and the sleeping beach town into a violet sky.
lettering: CAPTION: Up past the gulls, past the clouds, past the last of the night.
DELLA: Hold onto your bow tie!

pages.title: Page 5: The Lantern, wounded
pages.alt: In orbit, the Gull glides beside the dark Lantern. Its great dish is scarred and knocked off-axis as meteors streak past.
lettering: RUSTY: Meteor shower knocked the dish clean off its mark. It's beaming at the moon!
DELLA: Then we turn it back toward home. By hand.

pages.title: Page 6: The spacewalk
pages.alt: Della braces on the mast and heaves the dish around while Rusty, tethered, cranks a brass alignment wheel above the curve of the Earth.
lettering: RUSTY: Two degrees... one... MARK!
DELLA: Lantern's looking at El Segundo again!

pages.title: Page 7: Morning edition
pages.alt: Morning on the beach: kids, surfers and a lifeguard listen to radios as the Lantern glows again and the Gull streaks home.
lettering: RADIO: Good morning, South Bay! This is PointCast. Surf's two to three feet, skies clear, and the paper is on time.
CAPTION: 6:45 A.M. on the dot.
THE END... of the beginning!

items.title: Sunset Dockweiler Shore
items.alt: Abstract poster, not a photograph or a map. A large orange sun sets over teal ocean waves and a cream beach with a red lifeguard hut. Text reads El Segundo: Sunset · Dockweiler Shore.

items.title: Aerospace City
items.alt: Abstract poster, not a photograph or a map. A cream-and-red rocket rises through orbital arcs above low aerospace buildings and palm trees. Text reads El Segundo: Aerospace City.

items.title: Night Lights
items.alt: Abstract poster, not a photograph or a map. Dark refinery towers, pipes, and tanks glow with amber lights beneath a cream full moon. Text reads El Segundo: Night Lights.

items.title: Final Approach
items.alt: Abstract poster, not a photograph or a map. Three passenger jets with landing gear approach a lit runway beneath a teal sky and orange sunset. Text reads El Segundo: Final Approach.

items.title: Main Street & Rec Park
items.alt: Abstract poster, not a photograph or a map. A red pickleball paddle and yellow perforated ball rest on a green court beside colorful storefronts, a palm tree, and a water tower. Text reads El Segundo: Main Street · Rec Park.

items.title: PointCast On the Air
items.alt: Abstract poster, not a photograph or a map. A red radio tower sends concentric teal, cream, and orange signal rings over a bay at sunset. Text reads El Segundo: PointCast · On the Air.

art.title: The crew
art.alt: Crew poster: Capt. Della Marsh in a teal flight suit and Rusty Vance in a white shirt and red bow tie stand with the cream Gull, the Lantern behind them.

art.title: Travel poster
art.alt: Travel poster of retro-future El Segundo: the pier, a rocket gantry, art-deco towers, and the Lantern above a sunset bay. Text reads Visit El Segundo / Where tomorrow takes off / South Bay · California.

art.title: Lantern house ad
art.alt: House ad for the Lantern: the saucer station above the beach at sunrise, with a small radio in the foreground. Text reads Tune in to the Lantern! / The morning edition from the sky · Every day at 6:45 / PointCast / Weather · Tides · Swell · News.
